high_level_description: This black-and-white photograph captures the aftermath of the attack on Pearl Harbor, Hawaii, on December 7, 1941. The image is overlaid with text that reads "THIS DAY IN HISTORY" at the bottom, followed by the date "Dec. 7, 1941." Below this, additional text provides historical context: "Eighty-four years ago, the U.S. Navy base at Pearl Harbor in Hawaii was attacked by Japanese forces, killing more than 2,300 Americans.
